1 هَجَّتِ النَّارُ aor.
هَجِ3َ , inf. n. هَجِيجٌ and هَجٌّ; (L;) The fire burned fiercely, or intensely; or flamed, or blazed. or burned without smoke, fiercely, or intensely or, made a noise, or sound: هَجِيجُِ النَّار being the same as أَجِيجُهَا, (S, L, K) like as هَرَاقَ is the same as أَرَاقَ (S, L,) or, burned, and caused a sound, or noise, to be heard by its burning. (L.) ＝
-A2- See art. عَجَّ, last para.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
